declarations.docstring: Under the displayed matrix hypothesis, a nonzero nonnegative integer vector has the auxiliary property whenever it admits the stated transformation description.
For a symmetric integer matrix with the stated diagonal values, the auxiliary transformation indexed by a vertex list preserves its quadratic form.
For a symmetric integer matrix, the auxiliary transformation associated with a vector of quadratic value two preserves the quadratic form.
For a symmetric integer matrix whose selected coordinate vector has quadratic value two, the corresponding auxiliary transformation preserves the quadratic form.
